children: Patrick Soon-Shiong disclosed a 19.9% stake in PDS Biotechnology Corporation through Nant Capital, LLC. The filing follows an initial PIPE closing and his Sept. 14, 2026 appointment to the company’s board. The deal includes strict 19.9% ownership caps and gives his group board nomination rights tied to ownership levels.

Soon-Shiong joined the board and, while Nant Capital holds at least 15% of the company, he can "designate two individuals for appointment to the board," including himself. He and James Banaag plan to engage with management and shareholders on strategy, operations, governance, and potential transactions.

Nant Capital also committed to a milestone purchase of an additional $10 million of stock or pre-funded warrants once PDS submits a Phase 3 protocol for PDS0301, with all purchases and warrant exercises capped by a 19.9% blocker. Separately, an affiliate, NantWorks, received a one-year option to negotiate an exclusive license for the PDS0101 program.

Nant Capital, LLC is an investment firm focused on acquiring and holding securities and other assets, and Patrick Soon-Shiong is its sole member. Soon-Shiong is a physician-entrepreneur who leads the NantWorks ecosystem and has built and invested in multiple biotech ventures. He typically targets immunotherapy and oncology platforms, pairing capital with operational involvement and clinical development expertise.
